title: Farfarout Demo
author: MorophonBoundless
selftext:
Hi there,

I am just dropping this here, maybe you'll get a kick out of it ! [https://supercitron.itch.io/farfarout-demo](https://supercitron.itch.io/farfarout-demo)

1:1 Solar system recreation  
Newtonian physics  
Seamless planet landings

Coffee ???

... and more to discover :)

  
I just had to get it out there and get some feedback, I am not a gamedev (though I work in IT), I just wanted to be able to cruise the solar system at my own pace.

Didn't write a single line of code but I did steer the project end-to-end, this is not a "one shot prompt", it took me a few days with Opus 5.5

Enjoy !

comments.author: GCC_GicaCamelCase
comments.body: You should add a loading bar progress beside x/17. My internet is not the best and I'm not sure if it got stuck at 15/17 or not.

replies.author: MorophonBoundless
replies.body: Yes the first download might be a bit longer (planet/moons textures are being cached) but afterwards you should be fine

comments.author: vriemeister
comments.body:
I found some of the improved engines, maybe not the best ones, but is it supposed to still take an hour to get to farfarout? There's no timewarp while in supercruise so that seems a little excessive.

Really nice idea to add the gravity wells during those long trips to make a mini-game out of it, though.

replies.author: MorophonBoundless
replies.body:
Hey, thanks for playing ! So about your question, mostly yes, this game sits (maybe awkwardly) between an idle game and a regular active game when very long distances traveling is involved.  
  
>!Farfarout would be the end of the demo!< <- Don't reveal if you don't want spoils  
  
So there's some grind involved as you've already figured out with the engines. I am glad you like the mini games while in superdrive, I thought too that they were a nice addition to the boredom of ... well, flying 30 times the speed of light I guess !

Warms my heart the someone tried the game more than at a glance frankly ! Have a good one !

replies.author: vriemeister
replies.body:
Glad I could help:)

I perused the game data to find a better drive than the one at Ceres. I wouldn't have found it otherwise. You need some other way to guess what's at a location and what the market is besides travelling there. Maybe a bar/pub, local news stations, or gossip channels.

Oh, and clicking outside of the letter from Ellie closes it but clicking outside of the market window, etc, doesn't close those windows. I nearly had to restart the game at one point because I got locked into the market screen.

replies.author: MorophonBoundless
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback, I'll take all of it onto account to bring some much needed bugfixes !

If you want to try something completely different, I am working on [https://supercitron.itch.io/toyatu](https://supercitron.itch.io/toyatu) which is ... something like a low-poly driving sim with hard physics and interesting sounds
